title: Tactical RPG: how to play
sections: Your team of heroes fights a team of skeletons on a 3D battlefield. Defeat every enemy unit to win; if all of your heroes fall, you lose.

You and the enemy take turns. In your turn each hero can move once and act once. Tap a hero to pick it, then Move and tap a blue tile, or Attack and tap an enemy in range. Wait ends that hero's turn; End turn ends your whole turn and the skeletons move.

Knight: lots of health and a strong attack, but only hits enemies right next to him. Archer: moves far and shoots from a long range, but hits less hard. Cleric and Chemist: medium range and good damage, but more fragile.
Skeletons shoot from long range but break easily. Skeleton mages cast at medium range. The skeleton captain is slow but hits as hard as your knight.
Tiles have different heights. Every unit can only climb a certain height in one step (the archer climbs best, the knight worst), so the path you can take depends on who moves.
The arrow buttons move the camera, << and >> turn it, + and - zoom. Turn the camera when a unit is hidden behind a wall.
Put the knight in front to take the hits, and keep the archer at a distance. Gang up on one enemy at a time: a defeated enemy can't strike back.
